words.def: a flaw that stops something working properly
words.ex: The engineer found a {defect} in the boiler that was causing the heating to fail.

words.def: a seller's promise that a product will work for a certain period
words.ex: The fridge is still under {guarantee}, so the repair should be free.

words.def: a person who comes to fix or install equipment in your home
words.ex: The {engineer} came on Tuesday to look at the boiler.

words.def: a situation that causes difficulty or annoyance
words.ex: Having no hot water for two days has been a real {inconvenience}.

words.def: to put equipment in place so it is ready to use
words.ex: They {installed} the new oven last week, but it still doesn't work properly.

words.def: to repair something that is broken or not working
words.ex: The plumber came quickly to {fix} the leaking pipe.

words.def: not working properly because of a problem in how it was made
words.ex: The tap was {defective} when it arrived: it leaked from day one.

words.def: continuing for a long time, longer than expected or wanted
words.ex: The {persistent} smell of damp suggested there might be a leak behind the wall.
